---

## Summary

Every game must pass a review by 3 independent Stake Engine reviewers before going live. Each reviewer rates 0–3 stars. Average **≥ 2.0 stars** = enters full review. Below 2.0 = not published, resubmit within 3 days. A clean, complete submission can be live within 24–48 hours. An incomplete submission adds a full review cycle each time.

**This file is Ollie and Tiger's reference. Zacke should be aware of these criteria when building.**

---

## The Review Process

1. Submit game via ACP (thumbnail + frontend version + math version + math validation must all pass first)
2. Enters **rating queue** — 3 independent reviewers each assign a rating within **24 hours**; ratings hidden from each other
3. Average calculated:
   - **≥ 2.0 stars** → reviewer contacts you within a couple of days to begin full review
   - **< 2.0 stars** → not published — can resubmit within **3 days** after addressing issues
4. **Full review** — back-and-forth with assigned reviewer via email; fewer rounds = faster ship
5. All checklist items cleared → **Approved** → live on Stake within **24 hours** (usually hours)
6. Performance tracked live on dashboard (updates every 5 minutes)

**Every round of feedback costs time.** Self-review against the checklist before submitting is the single biggest speed lever we have.

### ACP Details (team: maxiai)
- ACP: `stake-engine.com/teams/maxiai`
- Game files: `stake-engine.com/teams/maxiai/games/{game}/files`
- Thumbnail: `stake-engine.com/teams/maxiai/games/{game}/thumbnail`

### Payout Details
- Processed monthly — closes at UTC midnight
- Invoice appears on payments page; funds sent to wallet within **12 hours**
- **Wallet address must be configured** — if unset, balance carries over (not lost, but delayed)

## Quality Rankings & What They Mean

| Stars | Standard | Platform placement |
|-------|----------|-------------------|
| ★★★ | Studio quality, exceptional creativity and polish | Featured, Burst Games, Stake Exclusives, New Releases (priority) |
| ★★ | Strong quality, clear originality | New Releases, Burst/Exclusives if popularity drives it |
| ★ | Meets minimum bar but low polish | **NOT published** — average must be ≥ 2.0 to enter full review |

**Our target is ★★ minimum, ★★★ where possible.**

---

## What Gets a Game to 3 Stars

- Tested across device sizes — no lag, no broken layouts
- Optimised bundle size — fast load times
- Cohesive, polished visual style — professional execution
- Depth in gameplay — bonus modes, extra mechanics, reasons to keep betting
- For Burst games specifically: the concept must be well-executed — simple concepts do not score well

---

## Common Rejection Reasons (memorise these)

- Shallow gameplay — players lose interest after 1–2 bets
- Generic AI-generated assets — stock gradients, emoji icons, standard fonts
- No bonus modes or additional mechanics
- Inconsistent or mismatched art styles
- Poor animation quality
- Missing mandatory features (Bet Replay, tile assets, language file)
- **Using SDK sample game assets** — backgrounds, symbols, or animations from the example games are explicitly banned
- **Console errors** — especially from external URLs being blocked by XSS policy (e.g. Google Fonts)
- **Missing in-game paytable/rules** — RTP and max win must be displayed in-game
- **Popout view broken** — game must work in Stake's mini-player modal without distortion
- **Spacebar not mapped** to the bet/spin button

---

## Key Restrictions (hard rules — automatic rejection)

- **Stateless only:** No jackpots, gamble features, early cashout, or continuation mechanics
- **Original games only:** No pre-purchased or licensed games from other platforms
- **No Stake™ branding** in game assets
- **No content appealing to minors** — includes child-like art in any gambling context
- **IP compliance:** All assets and names must be original or licensed
- **No external URLs:** All assets must load from Stake Engine CDN — no Google Fonts, no external libraries
- **No sample assets:** SDK example game art cannot be shipped in a submitted game
- **Post-approval:** Only minor visual fixes allowed after approval — math and mechanics are locked

---

## Mandatory Requirements (every submission)

### 1. Bet Replay
- **Required — games will not be approved without it**
- Must support replay via URL params: `replay=true, game, version, mode, event, rgs_url`
- No player session required for replay (URLs are publicly shareable)
- All betting UI must be disabled in replay mode
- Reviewers will test replay for every bet mode

**Event IDs to prepare for review:**
- [ ] Normal win
- [ ] Big win
- [ ] Win cap (max win)
- [ ] Loss (zero payout)
- [ ] Bonus round trigger (if applicable — one per mode)

### 2. Game Tile Assets
Required with every submission. Max 3MB combined for BG + FG.

| Asset | Spec | Naming convention |
|-------|------|-------------------|
| Background | High-res PNG or JPG — shows the game world | `GameTitle-BG.png` |
| Foreground | High-res PNG, transparent background — key character or item | `GameTitle-FG.png` |
| Provider logo | High-res PNG, transparent background — legible at small sizes | `ProviderName-Logo.png` |

### 3. Submission Blurb
- Short paragraph describing game **theme and mechanics**
- Used in promotional material and game description tag
- Must accompany every submission request

### 3b. Mandatory In-Game Disclaimer

Every game's rules popup must include this disclaimer (exact wording or equivalent):

> *Malfunction voids all wins and plays. A consistent internet connection is required. In the event of a disconnection, reload the game to finish any uncompleted rounds. The expected return is calculated over many plays. The game display is not representative of any physical device and is for illustrative purposes only. Winnings are settled according to the amount received from the Remote Game Server and not from events within the web browser. TM and © 2026 Stake Engine.*

### 4. Stake.us Language File (`sweeps_<lang>`)
Required for Stake.us eligibility (auto-applies to all games). Swap prohibited terms:

| Prohibited | Replacement |
|-----------|-------------|
| bet / bets / betting | play / plays / playing |
| wager | play |
| cash / money | coins |
| win feature | play feature |
| buy bonus / bonus buy | get bonus |
| deposit | get coins |
| withdraw | redeem |
| gamble | play |
| total bet | total play |
| stake (as a verb) | play amount |

Full list in `resources/stake-requirements.md`.

## Full UI Requirements Checklist (from frontend-communication.md)

Reviewers check every one of these:

- [ ] Unique audio and visual assets — no SDK sample art
- [ ] No visual bugs — no missing/broken assets or animations
- [ ] Popout/mini-player view supported — no distortion at small sizes
- [ ] Mobile support — all UI usable during screen scaling
- [ ] All assets loaded from Stake Engine CDN (no external URLs, no console errors)
- [ ] In-game rules/info accessible from UI
- [ ] RTP clearly displayed for each mode
- [ ] Maximum win amount clearly displayed for each mode
- [ ] All symbol payout combinations shown in paytable
- [ ] Special symbol values listed (multipliers, prize values, etc.)
- [ ] Feature trigger description (e.g. "3 Scatters award 10 free spins")
- [ ] UI guide describing button functionality
- [ ] Player can change bet size
- [ ] All bet levels from RGS auth response available
- [ ] Current balance displayed
- [ ] Non-zero win amounts clearly shown
- [ ] Multi-step wins animate incrementally to final amount
- [ ] Sound disable option present
- [ ] Spacebar mapped to bet/spin button
- [ ] Autoplay requires player confirmation — no consecutive bets from single click
- [ ] Fastplay mode (if present): win amounts and info still legible
- [ ] Network tab clean — no errors or leaked game data
- [ ] Tested with multiple currencies and languages
- [ ] General disclaimer text in rules popup
